$comment: Capability-level evaluation cases (SKILL_AUTHORING_STANDARD §8, RC-09). Developer-only, never shipped. Every capability listed in an existing recipe needs at least one positive and one negative case; validator V-22 enforces this. Positive: the entry skill is used and the recipe is read. Negative: the recipe is not read; 'skill' names the better fit or 'none'. 'checks' are behaviour assertions for a grader. Prompts never mention Chayen (REQ-03). Execution status: NOT_RUN for all cases (no runner or fixture repositories yet; see SKILL_QUALITY_GATES G-12).
